name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Paladin goes with Greataxe if and only if Wrenna goes with Bard.
Either Kael goes with Ranger, or Sable goes with Paladin — but not both.
Wrenna goes with at least one of Bard, Ranger, or Greataxe.

Wrenna, Rogue, and Rapier belong to different adventurers.
Ranger goes with neither Sable nor Dagger.
Rogue does not go with Orin if and only if Rogue does not go with Quarterstaff.
Between Dagger and Rapier, one goes with Ranger and the other with Wizard.
Dagger goes with either Sable or Ranger (but not both).
